deltas.constraint: A plugin may return an ordinary document/status=partial review-only Candidate, but a Core Attempt already in cancelling state rejects both succeeded and partial terminal commits with zero execution outcomes. The P0/P3 adapter must serialize the intended partial terminal before cancellation wins, or provide a separately authorized Core recovery route. This source does not reinterpret cancelled as publishable and never emits incomplete_stream.

The injected Broker adapter must return verified Skill chain Assets/receipts as bundle-backed skill-chain-ref/v1 values anchored to the preallocated final chapter ResultBundle/item. Stream-backed or bundleless refs are rejected.

Publication is a typed Core HTTP control operation, not a plugin worker/RPC authority. P0 composition must inject the adapter; Chapter Workflow only emits/validates the typed command/result and never writes正文.

The baseline has no public P5 settlement adapter and the first P1 Candidate slice stages document targets only. P0/P5 must inject a proposal-to-Candidate adapter for non-document Story State targets. Chapter Workflow neither imports P5 nor creates a local Story State authority.

stop_conditions: Do not mount the plugin until all required P0/P2/P3/P5 adapters are real and contract-verified.
Do not claim cancel-partial production integration from source-only tests.
Do not add a direct P5 import, Core repository handle,正文 writer, or second Story State store.
